surface: Goals, Today's three when there is no active Goal
scope: In the selected daily field, open the exact available unfinished Quest from its row. Keep completed and set-aside rows informational, preserve selected field and Quest state, and demote the general Quest-board route. Carry exact Quest identity through the existing Goals-to-Quests handoff, including duplicate titles. Do not change the chooser, Goal focus, Quest completion, or persistence model.
user_job: After choosing up to three things for today, enter one chosen unfinished Quest directly and keep completed work visible without doing it twice.

active_sources.judged_state: The current no-active-Goal daily field has selected Quest rows that cannot enter their exact work.

product.decision: The chosen available row leads to the same Quest instance already in today's field, including when another Quest has the same title. Completed and set-aside rows remain visible records; no row completes or mutates a Quest.
product.proof: Use open, completed, and set-aside selected Quests; assert only the available row dispatches, with no persistence or general-board navigation. Exercise the actual AppShell Goals-to-Quests route and return, and use duplicate titles on the board to prove the requested instance owns the arrival and first card.

interaction.decision: The whole available row responds at pointer down and exposes an Open Quest semantic action. Completed and set-aside rows have no action. The general board link stays available but quiet.
interaction.proof: Exercise row touch and semantics, including a set-aside row; verify at least a 44 px available-row target at enlarged text, and inspect both selected states for a clear route without an extra bright control.

visual.decision: Keep the existing smoked-glass field and typographic hierarchy. A small directional mark identifies available rows; completed rows retain a check, and set-aside rows show their state. The field does not become a stack of bright buttons.
visual.proof: Compare same-state before and after 430x932 and 320x568/1.5x renders, including one open and one completed row.

anti_fallbacks.fallback: Send every row to the general Quest board.
anti_fallbacks.why: It loses the exact item the person chose and asks them to find it again.

anti_fallbacks.fallback: Make completed rows open a second completion path.
anti_fallbacks.why: A completed row is proof for today, not another task.

anti_fallbacks.fallback: Turn every row into a new gold button.
anti_fallbacks.why: Equal bright actions would flatten the field's hierarchy and color every item.

first_real_slice.scenario: A person with no active Goal has chosen Read ten pages, Clear the desk, and Take a walk. The desk Quest is complete and the walk is set aside. They tap Read ten pages from Today's three.
first_real_slice.real_inputs: Three real Quest instances in the existing dated field, one lastDoneDay stamped and one snoozedDay stamped for today; the existing GoalsPage onOpenQuest callback and no active Goal.
first_real_slice.user_action: Tap the available selected row, then the completed and set-aside rows.
first_real_slice.expected_outcome: The first tap opens the exact Read ten pages Quest instance; the other rows do nothing; field selection and persistence remain unchanged.
first_real_slice.state_boundary: This slice dispatches navigation only. It never marks a Quest done or writes daily-field state.

required_states.state: 430x932 Goals field with one unfinished and one completed selected Quest
required_states.why_can_disprove: A general board route or bright rows could still overshadow the selected work.

required_states.state: 320x568 with 1.5x text, the same selected field, and Reduced Motion
required_states.why_can_disprove: The new directional mark could squeeze the title or leave a small target.

required_states.state: 430x932 Goals field with an available, completed, and set-aside selected Quest
required_states.why_can_disprove: A nonactionable set-aside row could look like another route or lose its state explanation.

required_states.state: Tap available, completed, and set-aside rows, then hand off among duplicate-title Quest cards
required_states.why_can_disprove: A plausible tap affordance could route to an absent or wrong Quest or alter selection.

required_states.state: Stored selected Quest enters Quests from Goals, then a later ordinary Quests tab visit
required_states.why_can_disprove: The shell could drop live Quest identity or leave a one-shot arrival permanently featured.

ripple_map.state: Available, completed, and set-aside dated Quest rows
ripple_map.expected_effect: Only available rows open their exact Quest; completed and set-aside rows remain informational.
ripple_map.verification_plan: Focused exact-instance widget journey and selected-field renders.

ripple_map.expected_effect: The exact object chosen in Goals is the first and featured arrival card, regardless of title collision.
ripple_map.verification_plan: Focused board widget journey using duplicate-title Quest instances, plus full AppShell stored-state tap and return.

ripple_map.surface_or_primitive: Footer route from Today's three to Quests
ripple_map.state: Selected field with an unfinished Quest
ripple_map.expected_effect: Board navigation remains available without competing visually with the selected row.
ripple_map.verification_plan: Inspect same-state before and after captures and confirm callback separation.

ripple_map.state: 320x568, 1.5x text, Reduced Motion, long Quest titles
ripple_map.expected_effect: The whole row stays operable and its text remains readable without clipping.
ripple_map.verification_plan: Focused widget assertions and a fresh narrow capture.

unverified_property: Whether direct row entry and its quiet directional mark feel obvious, comfortable, and cohesive on the owner's physical phone.

decisive_check.method: Use today's selected field on a physical phone: open the unfinished Quest by tapping its title or row edge, return, then inspect the completed row and general board link.
decisive_check.target: A day with one available, one completed, and one set-aside selected Quest at ordinary and enlarged text.
decisive_check.pass_condition: The available work is the obvious next route, its row responds under the finger, completed and set-aside work do not reopen as actions, and the field still feels like one authored surface.
